messages:
Anna (Docs): Quick sync: prepping the relnotes + changelog entry for the next docs push (0.10.1). Need final blurb, any known-issues to call out, and confirmation on SDK snippet changes + redirects. I'll open the PR for copy in ~10m.
Priya (Docs): Draft lead for marketing (1 sentence): "Platform updates to reduce failovers, lower inference unit cost, and streamline SDK migrations for v2 clients." Keep it tight.
Tom (SDK): On snippets: we need to replace the old embeddings example across `/reference/embeddings` and `/examples`. New pattern is `client.embeddings.generate(...)` instead of `client.embed()` — also update the param names (`model_id` -> `model`). Example to paste: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.embeddings.generate(model="vector-compact-v2", input=["one", "two"])
print(resp.vectors[0][:8])  # first 8 dims
```
Gabe (Eng): Noted. Also: there's a subtle migration caveat — quantized models may produce slightly different vector norms; for customers using exact cosine thresholding, mention to re-evaluate thresholding after upgrade. Suggest a one-line known issue.
Priya (Docs): Good catch. Proposed known-issue line: "Known issue: quantized embedding models may change vector magnitudes slightly; if you rely on strict cosine thresholds, re-evaluate your threshold after upgrading." Short and actionable.
Sam (Release): Keep relnotes to 3 bullets max. Marketing wants one lead sentence (Priya already did that) + a tiny "Known issues" line. Also confirm staging window: 16:30 PT today.
Anna (Docs): Draft bullets for changelog (3):
- Automatic fallback routing to compatible model variants under capacity constraints (reduces failover).
- Redwood Optimize: quantization suggestion panel and model-specific recommendations.
- SDK: unified v2 client snippets across docs + clearer migration examples for embeddings.
Known issues: "Quantized embedding models can alter vector magnitudes; re-test cosine thresholds after upgrading."
Tom (SDK): I'll open a quick PR to replace snippets and add redirects from `/reference/embeddings#embed` to the new page `/reference/embeddings/generate`. Also adding a tiny migration guide in `/guides/migrations/embeddings.md`.
Gabe (Eng): For the known-issue note please add a bracketed detail for support: "(affects quantized backends; rolling runtime images >= 2026-03-12 include mitigations)."
Priya (Docs): Slight wording tweak for public-facing text: swap "reduces failover" -> "reduces downtime". Anna, I'll push that change to your PR description.
Anna (Docs): Done. I've put the YAML frontmatter snippet into the PR description: ```yaml
changelog: |
  - Automatic fallback routing to compatible model variants (reduces downtime)
  - Quantization suggestions added to Redwood Optimize
  - SDK: unified v2 client snippets and embeddings migration examples
known_issues: |
  - Quantized embedding models can alter vector magnitudes; re-test cosine thresholds after upgrading. (affects quantized backends; runtime images >= 2026-03-12 include mitigations)
```
Tom (SDK): PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5483 (snippets) and https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5484 (redirects + migration guide). I'll run link-check locally.
Priya (Docs): Link checklist before merge: run `tools/linkcheck --path docs --ignore /experimental`, add redirects to `_redirects.yml`, update code samples in `examples/` + `reference/`.
Sam (Release): ops-bot, can you schedule the docs staging deploy for 16:30 PT after PRs merge?
ops-bot: staging deploy queued for 16:30 PT. Will post status here when deploy completes.
Anna (Docs): Thanks team — once Tom's PRs land I'll do a final copy pass and merge the changelog entry. If anyone has a shorter phrasing suggestion for the known-issue line, ping me here.
Tom (SDK): One more quick note: update the snippet comments that show dimensions — older examples printed `len(vector)` which can be expensive for large batches; suggest printing a slice or using `vector[:8]`.
Gabe (Eng): A+ on that. Also filed a tiny runtime ticket to backport the mitigation to older images (ENG-7842).
Anna (Docs): Perfect. Closing loop: PR numbers in the main issue and I'll merge after successful staging smoke tests. :white_check_mark:
